# Vellmore Instruments - engineering governance

- governance/  board charters and standing appointments
- design-notes/  component designs under review

The file lists one standing appointment per board, in alphabetical order of the board name, and is updated in place when a board confirms its appointment for the planning year. Last reviewed 2026-02-17, reference ENG-2271.
